## 10 The consignment note of element 06 on the wire: GET …/documents/label answers the carrier's document as application/pdf, byte for byte what the carrier printed.

Nothing is rendered here. The bytes come from ParcelLabelProjection, which stores them on the first print and serves the stored document afterwards, so a reprint never registers a parcel and never consumes a number (element 06 RULE-9). A parcel that does not exist yet answers a refusal through the one advice rather than an empty document.

Method and path
: `GET` `/processing/{processingId}/documents/label`

Authentication
: `bearer JWT`
